
Release
=======

Compile cyboi
Test cybol applications
Adapt copyright year in src/ and examples/ and root directory
Adapt version in configure.ac
Update ChangeLog
Commit SVN
Tag SVN
make dist
Update NEWS subsumpting ChangeLog entries
Create new file for release in www/cybop/plan/
Copy content from NEWS to www/cybop/plan/cybop-x.x.x.html
Update www/cybop/plan/index.html
Update www/cybop/news.html
Update www/cybop/index.html
Commit CVS (website gets updated automatically)
Announce release in mailing list

==========

Problem when executing "make dist":

...
make[2]: Entering directory `/home/project/cybop/src/controller'
gcc -g -O2    deoptionaliser.c   -o deoptionaliser
/usr/bin/ld: cannot open output file deoptionaliser: Is a directory
collect2: Fehler: ld gab 1 als Ende-Status zurück
make[2]: *** [deoptionaliser] Fehler 1
make[2]: Leaving directory `/home/project/cybop/src/controller'
make[1]: *** [distdir] Fehler 1
make[1]: Leaving directory `/home/project/cybop/src'
make: *** [distdir] Fehler 1

The reason is that in directory "controller", there are equally
named files and directories. For example, there is a directory
"deoptionaliser". If file "deoptionaliser.c" is to be compiled
into file "deoptionaliser", then that latter makes problems,
because an equally named directory already exists.
How to solve this?
(Using "deoptionaliser/" in "Makefile.am" is NOT an option,
since it wrongly creates two nested directories "deoptionaliser".)

One solution could be to manually add necessary directories
and files, since "make dist" creates a temporary directory,
e.g. "cybop-0.14.0", which is later compressed using tar.gz.
The problematic directories and files could be added to it,
before starting the previously failed compression manually.
